COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY
OFFICE OF CLAIMS AND APPEALS
BOARD OF TAX APPEALS

APPEAL NO. K25-S-002

CONDOR PROPERTIES, LLC APPELLANT
v. ORDER DISMISSING
BOYD COUNTY CLERK APPELLEE

This matter has been pending with the Board since the filing of the Notice of Appeal by
the Appellant on or about April 10, 2025. The matter was thereafter served upon the Appellee and
assigned to a hearing officer. Thereafter, the Appellant informed the Clerk of the Board that he
desired to withdraw the appeal as the parties had reached an accord. There was no objection to
the motion by the Appellee.

Based on the foregoing, and being otherwise sufficiently advised, the matter is HEREBY
DISMISSED upon the motion of the Petitioner.

SO ORDERED on this_2& 4 day of June, 2025.
